quests.instruction: TAP FLOATING EMOJIS AND CONSTRUCT A SITUATION DESCRIPTION
quests.situation: [Diver Prompt 121-1] Describe how deep hydrothermal vents release superheated chemical compounds.
quests.hint: Focus on hot springs expelling rich black plumes of sulfide minerals. (Diving calibration index 121-1)
quests.explanation: Vents erupt superheated solutions containing hydrogen sulfide and sulfur particles. [Verified by Creative Cartographer Unit 121].

quests.instruction: TAP FLOATING EMOJIS AND CONSTRUCT A SITUATION DESCRIPTION
quests.situation: [Microbe Prompt 121-2] Describe the survival mechanism of marine bacteria in dark abyssal plains.
quests.hint: Describe how microbes convert chemical energy without any sunlight. (Diving calibration index 121-2)
quests.explanation: Microscopic deep marine bacteria perform chemosynthesis to convert chemicals to sugars. [Verified by Creative Cartographer Unit 121].

quests.instruction: TAP FLOATING EMOJIS AND CONSTRUCT A SITUATION DESCRIPTION
quests.situation: [Microbe Prompt 121-3] Describe the photosynthetic layers of giant underwater kelp forests.

quests.explanation: Kelp plants utilize chloroplasts to absorb solar beams, growing up to two feet daily. [Verified by Creative Cartographer Unit 121].
